'''Joli''' was a member of the [[Scavenger Young]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. During the [[Young–Elders War]], he and [[Deila]] informed [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] of [[Mawat]]'s treachery.
